title: Navbar Logo + CourseCard Mobile Layout Fixes
content:
Two minor mobile fixes:

**C1 — Navbar logo (Minor)**
The Navbar logo's clipPath polygon may protrude horizontally on small screens (< 375px). Fix: use responsive clipPath or switch to `overflow-hidden` container with max-width on the SVG.
- src/components/Navbar.tsx

**C2 — CourseCard flex-col mobile layout (Minor)**
After CC-001 refactor, CourseCard uses `flex-col md:flex-row`. On mobile, the poster `w-1/3` should become full-width, and text sizing should remain readable.
- Verify: poster is `w-full` on mobile (`md:w-1/3`)
- No text overflow on narrow viewports
- src/components/courses/CourseCard.tsx

Risk: low
Depends: none
acceptance: Navbar logo does not protrude horizontally at 320px viewport width
CourseCard poster is full-width on mobile (w-full), 1/3 on md+
CourseCard text does not overflow or truncate oddly on mobile
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && Chrome DevTools 375px viewport — Navbar logo fits, CourseCard poster is full-width
